A village girl Paro (Hema Malini) is much sought after by one and many. When she falls in love with Dr. Paras (Sanjeev Kumar). Paras gets beaten and Paro herself was blinded. But Paras survives and Dr. Singh and his Daughter Dr. Manju (Yogeeta Bali) look after him. Then one day a well wisher enters Paro's life promising to restore her eyesight. He is none other than Dr. Paras who is now engaged to Dr. Manju. What happens next forms the crux of Dhoop Chhaon.
